name: Somniferous Blossom Rod

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Druidcraft, Overgrowth and Insect Plague, plant mending, and once a day a 30-ft wave of sleep.
text: While holding this rod you can cast Druidcraft at will and, once per dawn, Plant Growth (its Overgrowth only). As a Magic action you can restore the ordinary plants in a 5-foot cube you can see within 15 feet to full health for 1d4 days. Once per dawn you can also cast Insect Plague from it, using your spell save DC. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or fall Unconscious for 1 hour; taking damage, or someone within 5 feet using an action to shake them, wakes them. Creatures that don't sleep, or are immune to Exhaustion, succeed automatically.

powers.name: Overgrowth
powers.text: Once a day: Plant Growth's Overgrowth.
